verdict.rationale: Live multi-user sync is a fair question for a collaborative work tracker like Jira, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents changes propagating instantly to open sessions without a refresh. The 'stay up-to-date' marketing lines refer to views and automation, not live session sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
